description: Lindybeige primarily features the host discussing and dissecting ancient and medieval warfare, weapons, and historical technology, often correcting misconceptions found in movies or games. The videos are typically long, unscripted-style rants or explanations delivered directly to the camera, covering everything from the practical realities of historical combat to nitpicking Hollywood's inaccurate portrayal of tactics and equipment. Beyond military history, the channel is eclectic, including videos on swing dance, evolutionary psychology, travelogues, and general geekery.
